name: Awareness of the outside and interaction with it
vision_statement: The AI system optimally learns and interacts with the world outside of it.
opportunities: Tool categories as solutions, with integrations as their implementations, go beyond bringing in a web search, and a category can gain a better integration without any product rewriting its code. The models the hub asks and the freshness of its research change with the outside too.
solution_coherence: World is how the system learns what is outside it and acts on it. Science returns observations of public research that a reader can cite. Tools lets the AI use the tool of a category through Web Search, File Reading, File Editing, Connected System Operations or Delegated Agent Sessions, and refuses a category the authority does not allow. File Editing makes its one-call edit through Vendor Model Caller at the tier that Model Tier Chooser picks. Model Plumbing is how every part asks a model, through Model Tier Chooser and Vendor Model Caller. Vendor Model Caller steps to the next provider when one fails. Learning keeps the research current by reading dates through Research Freshness Reader.
